title: The First Descent
summary: The crew reached the Central Row of the Hollow Orchard and found a sealed door.
content:
We entered [[g-21]] at low tide. Inside, no time seemed to pass; our watches disagreed by an hour on the way out.

## Findings
- A sealed stone door at the end of the Central Row
- Inscriptions that resemble those in [[the-karthian-flood-myth]]

## Losses
- One lantern, left burning by the door
author: Records Office
